_why: Declares every depth-1 component directory under the listed roots and the document that names it, so a new class of component cannot enter the repository silently. Read by scripts/component_inventory.py (folded into the validator's component-docs check). A class is a directory holding at least one tracked or not-ignored file; declare it in `surfaces` with a `doc` that actually names it (token-checked) or in `exempt` with a real reason.
